messages.content: Hey — weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been treating you alright. Got a blood pressure reading for me today?
Logged, thank you. Any symptoms this week, or anything off with your medications?
No, nothing like that. Actually — any chance you can help with a prior auth? Insurance has been holding up my metoprolol refill for a week now.
I'm sorry, insurance and prior authorizations are outside what I'm able to do right now. Your pharmacy or your provider's office would be the right call for that one. Anything else before I wrap up?
All set. I'll send your next check-in same time next week. Take care out there.

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
